entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
I need to return something.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Alex Rowan. The order is VF55-B291-C8.

Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, which was delivered on December 28th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It works. I just changed my mind.
I see. And you're just not finding it useful for your routine?
Look, I just don't use it. It was an impulse buy.

I understand. Thank you for clarifying that for me. Looking at the return policy for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, it does have a strict 10-day return window from the day it's delivered. Since we're on day 16 now, I'm afraid I can't process a return for a refund.
Ten days? Seriously? That's just great.

I do apologize for the frustration. That specific policy is in place because once the Pulse is activated, the hardware gets permanently linked to a user's account for security. However, I do have an alternative solution for you.
Fine. What is it?

Since it's in good condition, your best option would be our new VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's an official platform where you can sell your gear directly to other VeloFit community members. You'd likely get most of your money back that way, and we don't take any fees.
So now I have to be a salesman? Wonderful.

It does give you the most control over the price, and you're connecting with buyers who are specifically looking for that device. Since you confirmed you just don't use it and it works fine, a private resale is a great way to go. I can email you the direct link with instructions. Would you like me to do that?
Yeah, whatever. Send the link.
Of course. I've just sent that information to the email we have on file for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day, Alex.
